name: nushell
description: Two skills and the Nushell language server, no hooks. nushell: writing, debugging and configuring Nushell 0.116 — the language, structured data, modules, plugins, completions, $env.config, hooks, keybindings, the stdlib, the built-in MCP server — and Nustro, the distro, when it is the shell. nustro-completion-build: teach Tab a CLI, a completions/<tool>.nu for Nustro's engine. `nu --lsp` for .nu files: diagnostics after each edit, definitions, references, hover.
